Wärtsilä uses an online solution for supply-chain risk identification.

Wärtsilä uses an online solution for supply chain risk identification, assessment, and monitoring. More than 2,000 suppliers have been, and continue to be, followed through the system. The solution includes a selection of key criteria defined by Wärtsilä, against which the situation of each supplier is continuously measured. Any
The evidence establishes that Wärtsilä used an online solution for supply-chain risk identification in 2019, but does not establish its use in the 2022 reporting year.
